meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比本地代码与已发布版本，列出未发布的变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要知道哪些代码改动还没发布到npm
copy.tagline_en: Compare local code with published npm versions and list unpublished changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know which code changes are not yet published to npm

howto.what: 安装后，当你说出触发词，Claude 会对比仓库当前代码与已发布的 npm 版本，找出尚未发布的改动，按组件、工具插件、配置等层级分类列出，并给出各层建议的版本号升级方案。
howto.when: 当你提到“未发布的改动”“变更日志”“改了什么”等关键词，或要求查看仓库新改动时触发。

say.text: 对比最新发布的版本，列出所有未发布的改动
say.note: Claude 会比较代码差异并分类输出

say.text: 生成一份未发布的变更日志
say.note: 按功能、修复、重构分组列出

say.text: 看看代码库有哪些改动还没发版
say.note: 会检查三个发布层并建议版本号

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude compares the current repo against the latest published npm versions, lists unpublished changes by release layers, and suggests version bumps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', etc.

say_en.text: Compare with the latest published version and list all unpublished changes.
say_en.note: Claude diffs the code and groups the output.
Grouped by feat, fix, and refactor.

say_en.text: What changes in the repo are not yet released?
say_en.note: Checks the three layers and suggests versions.
